claim: DN Brasil, 10 November 2025, reported 151 participants selected by ApexBrasil for Brazil's 2025 Web Summit delegation: 80 from the Southeast and 35 from the Northeast.

Startups.com.br, 3 November 2025, quoting ApexBrasil, reported 340 startups and innovative companies in Brazil's 2025 delegation: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae and 84 brought by partners Softex, Anprotec and Serpro.
Startups.com.br reported that 123 of the 340 companies in the 2025 delegation were attending Web Summit for the first time.
DN Brasil, 10 November 2025, reported more than 370 startups based in Brazil in the 2025 delegation.
ApexBrasil's rules for its 2026 mission give almost 380 companies for the 2025 delegation, counting the 247 supported companies plus those of the state Sebrae branches.
ApexBrasil's rules for its 2026 mission give 247 'startups e empresas inovadoras' supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae and Serpro for 2025.
ApexBrasil told Lusa, reported in Forbes Portugal on 7 November 2023, that Brazil had 80 companies at Web Summit in 2022, the year of its first Brazil Pavilion.
Before the 2023 summit, Brazil planned a 'record' of 85 startups and 100 companies, according to the same Forbes Portugal report.
Startups.com.br, 3 November 2025, reported that 226 startups were selected for Brazil's 2024 delegation by ApexBrasil and Sebrae.
ApexBrasil says Brazil's 2025 Web Summit delegation was one of the two largest, along with Germany's.
Public figures for Brazil's 2026 Web Summit delegation range from 100 to about 300.
ApexBrasil's 2026 rules promise selected startups a place in a 'catálogo digital da delegação brasileira' on its Buy Brazil platform.
